description: The line plot illustrates the BPC (Bits Per Character) values for two validation processes—SMoE Validation and SimSMoE Validation—across training steps, with the x-axis representing training steps on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50,000 (labeled as (x10) for clarity), and the y-axis showing BPC values from 1.2 to 2.2. The black line, representing SMoE Validation, begins at a BPC of approximately 2.2 and exhibits a sharp decline, stabilizing around 1.4 after about 10,000 training steps. The magenta line, representing SimSMoE Validation, starts at a slightly lower BPC of approximately 2.1 and also decreases rapidly, leveling off around 1.4 after 10,000 steps. Both lines converge and remain closely aligned for the remainder of the training, with the SimSMoE Validation line showing a slightly lower BPC value than the SMoE Validation line after the initial drop.
